messages:
Alice Chen: Quick pass on the routing policy editor - focused on priority ordering & preview. Not urgent but noticed a few UX/AX issues from today's design review. TL;DR: drag affordance is weak, validation toasts are confusing, preview can be stale.
Ben Park: Thanks — can you list the nitpicks? I can queue them for next sprint.
Alice Chen: Short list: 1) drag handle is small/not touch-friendly 2) inline validation shows toast that disappears too fast 3) preview doesn't auto-refresh on reorder 4) keyboard move isn't discoverable 5) contrast on focus ring low.
Samir Gupta: On drag: current impl uses 12px handle. Suggest expand to full-row drag zone on desktop, and show grab cursor. On touch, make entire card draggable. Also show drop target highlight.
Maya Ortiz: A11y notes: use role="list"/"listitem" + aria-posinset & aria-setsize. Announce reorders via aria-live="polite". Keyboard shortcuts: support Shift+Alt+Arrow to reorder; announce 'Moved to position X of Y'. Contrast: focus outline needs 3:1 at least.
Zoe Li: Copy nits: validation 'Rule cannot be above higher priority' is unclear. Proposal: 'This rule has lower priority than the target rule. To raise priority, move it above.' For empty preview: 'Run simulation to preview routing behavior' + button 'Run now'.
Alice Chen: Bug: when preview panel is open then you reorder rules the preview doesn't update until you close/open the sandbox. Repro: open sim -> reorder -> preview unchanged.
deploy-bot: Preview sandbox redeployed (build #5321) :rocket: 
Samir Gupta: I'll add a quick fix: call refreshSimulation() on dragend and add debounce(250ms). Should be a tiny PR.
Maya Ortiz: Test plan: keyboard reorder + SR announcements (VoiceOver/JAWS), focus states, contrast checker. Expected SR message: 'Rule X moved to position 2 of 5.'
Ben Park: Nice. Can you add the spec to Figma and a brief checklist? Assigning to @Alice (design) + @Samir (eng) + @Maya (a11y). Sprint 42 target. :thumbsup: 
Alice Chen: Will do — linking Figma now: https://www.figma.com/file/abc-redwood-routing-priority
Samir Gupta: Adding tickets and telemetry events (policy.reorder, ui.preview.refresh). I'll ping when PR is up.
Maya Ortiz: I'll schedule a quick a11y review once PR is merged. Prefer to block release until SR announcements verified.
Zoe Li: thanks team. small follow-up: add microcopy for 'stale' indicator: 'Preview last run 3m ago — run now to refresh.'
